instruction.text: Read the text and solve the problem.

atoms.a: There are <mat>400</mat> rabbits in the park. It is expected that the population will grow by <mat>12%</mat> in the next year. How many rabbits will there be by the end of next year?

instruction.text: Read the text and solve the problem.

atoms.a: There are also many mice in the park, with a population of <mat>580</mat> members. <mat>45%</mat> of the mice are female. How many male mice are there?

instruction.text: Read the text and solve the problem.

atoms.a: Once it gets colder in the park, many birds migrate to warmer places. The Rufus Hummingbird already flew <mat>68%</mat> of its <mat>3000</mat> mile journey. How many miles does it still have to fly?

instruction.text: Read the text and solve the problem.

atoms.a: In the park, there are also squirrels with red, grey or brown fur. The park ranger counted a total of <mat>280</mat> squirrels. Given that <mat>20%</mat> have red fur and <mat>70%</mat> have grey fur, how many squirrels have brown fur?

instruction.text: Read the text and solve the problem.

atoms.a: Squirrels collect and hide nuts all around the park, so they have enough food during the cold days in winter. Researchers found that each squirrel buries about 420 nuts. However, it doesn’t retrieve <mat>25%</mat> of them. How many of each squirrel’s nuts will stay in the ground?
